overall: The AG found the Natick School Committee did not violate the Open Meeting Law: it reviewed the complaint within 14 business days, and open meeting law complaints may be reviewed in Purpose 1 executive session.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the committee failed to review, within 14 business days, a prior open meeting law complaint he had filed.
allegations.key_passage: Accordingly, we find that the Committee reviewed the complaint within 14 business days and was permitted to conduct its review in executive session during the March 26 meeting, and therefore did not violate the Open Meeting Law.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged that discussing open meeting law complaints in executive session violated the law and did not qualify as the required review of the complaint.
allegations.key_passage: We have determined that an Open Meeting Law complaint is by its nature “brought against[] a public officer,” namely, the members of the public body.
